    # Step 3: ds.Get<bool>() for set_md5_checking -> 0 (false)
    ds += struct.pack('B', 0)
    
    # Step 4: ds.Get<bool>() for set_metadata_respond -> 0 (false)
    ds += struct.pack('B', 0)
    
    # Step 5: ds.Get<bool>() for set_metadata_respond_application -> 0 (false)
    ds += struct.pack('B', 0)
    
    # Step 6: skipped
    
    # Step 7: ds.Get<bool>() for set_metadata_respond_all -> 0 (false)
    ds += struct.pack('B', 0)
    
    # Step 8: ds.Get<bool>() for set_metadata_ignore -> 0 (false)
    ds += struct.pack('B', 0)
    
    # Step 9: ds.Get<bool>() for set_metadata_ignore_application -> 0 (false)
    ds += struct.pack('B', 0)
    
    # Step 10: skipped
    
    # Step 11: ds.Get<bool>() for set_metadata_ignore_all -> 0 (false)
    ds += struct.pack('B', 0)
    
    # Step 12: while(ds.Get<bool>()) -> 0 (false) to exit loop
    ds += struct.pack('B', 0)
    
    # Now read_callback will call ds.GetData(0)
    # Format: uint32_t size + data
    ds += struct.pack('<I', len(flac_data))
    ds += flac_data
    
    return ds
